announcements.text: (In a dramatic voice) Fake news. (pause) We count on AI to catch it. But what happens when the news isn’t written the way the AI expects? Next Tuesday, (pause) in Room 136, during the Radical Researchers Society gathering, Vishnu Penumethsa (pe-noo-met-suh) will tell you. Most AI fake-news detectors learned from only one kind of English: standard American. So researchers took thousands of real and fake news articles and rewrote them in 50 different English dialects, and tested different AI models on them. Be sure to come next Tuesday at lunch to Room 136 to hear Vishnu explain who gets left unprotected, and how the problem could actually be fixed. Snacks will be provided.
announcements.title: Radical Researchers Society

announcements.text: (In a dramatic voice) AI hallucination (pause) . We have all heard it before. But what does it really mean? Next Tuesday, (pause), in Room 136, during the Radical Researchers Society gathering, Rihaan Jain will discuss exactly that. Today, AI models have access to a box of information that it knows to be true. Since it's so much, however, the information must be organized. When an AI is unable to track down the right information in its large database, it hallucinates. Be sure to come next Tuesday lunch to Room 136 to hear Rihaan explain the problem in more detail, and how such hallucination can be measured through intentional experiments. Rumor on the street is that spicy chips will be provided.
announcements.title: Radical Researchers Society

announcements.text: (In a serious, dramatic voice) We are [pause] The Radical Researchers Society. (downwards inflection) If you want to be able to write your own novel research. (downwards inflection) If you are planning to apply to summer research programs. Next Tuesday in room 136, our very own Tejo Madhavarapu, will be presenting his MIT-Primes Research on the Galois Duel. In this game, we see that given two duelists that take turns firing at each other, there is a way to remove the advantage of being the first to shoot, through cleverly changing the firing order. Come to room 136 during lunch next Tuesday, to listen in on his clever solution.
announcements.title: Radical Researchers Society

announcements.text: Firebirds, Need a ride? Beam there! Getting to school, practice, a job, the library or a friend’s house just got easier.
